key_findings: Innervated vasculature-on-a-chip: DRG neurons co-cultured with endothelial cells showed enhanced capsaicin responses and increased TRPV1 expression.
Platform models acid nociception with dose-dependent responses to decreasing pH, in murine and human DRG neurons.
